note: Regional park in the North Saskatchewan River valley 8 km S of Maymont on Hwy 376, with a spring-fed swimming pond, a three-hole sand-greens golf course, disc golf and ball diamonds. Sites are shaded by poplar and willow brush. A light-boat launch is just past the gate. --Claude
summary: Keep. Accredited regional park, 61 sites (28 full-service 20/30 A, 10 electric, 23 non-electric), C$25-42 a night, entry C$10/day, May 1 - Sep 15 (stored closes 09-30 -> 09-15). Booking by phone/email (first night non-refundable). Nightly share: the only seasonal rate is for the 13 30-amp full-service sites, so at least 48 of 61 (79%) sell by the night. Google 4.1 (59). Not waterfront confirmed (river 250 m+ below through woods). Pin fine.
flags: NIGHTLY SHARE: SRPA fee table posts daily rates for every site class and a seasonal rate only for '30 Amp Full Service' (13 sites), so at most 13 of 61 are seasonal: at least 48 (79%) are sold by the night. WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. Esri z16: the loops sit around 52.4950-52.4960,-107.7000..-107.6980 on the valley bench; the North Saskatchewan is 250-350 m south through continuous poplar woods. The swimming pond is a dammed spring pond, not a waterfront.
